Name: Professional Morris
Author: AirynS
Description:
Changes Morris's portraits and sprites to keep his vanilla design, but tweak it a little so that Morris looks less like a cartoon villain and more like a professional businessman (who is still an unpleasant person).

To install, simply extract the “[CP] Professional Morris” folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

Created for [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/225898/mods]KediDili[/url]! Be sure to check out her mods!

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]:

This mod is automatically compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12824?]Marry Morris [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url].

If you are using Diverse Stardew Valley and would like a version that includes seasonal outfits, a DSV-compatible version is available in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23918]DSV Additional Characters - Townspeople[/url].

[b]This mod is not compatible with SVE and I will not offer compatibility for it.[/b] Posts asking about SVE compatibility will be deleted.
